description: Na₄Cu₂S₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/a space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form corner-sharing NaS₄ tetrahedra. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaS₄ tetrahedra. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.88 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are two shorter (2.87 Å) and two longer (2.89 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.81 Å) and two longer (2.85 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are two shorter (2.85 Å) and two longer (2.87 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.76-2.84 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Cu sites. In the first Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two S atoms. There is one shorter (2.16 Å) and one longer (2.17 Å) Cu-S bond length. In the second Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two S atoms. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and one longer (2.16 Å) Cu-S bond length. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Na and two Cu atoms to form SNa₄Cu₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SNa₄Cu₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent SNa₆Cu pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₆Cu pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-68°. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Cu atom. In the third S site, S is bonded to six Na and one Cu atom to form distorted SNa₆Cu pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent SNa₄Cu₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SNa₆Cu pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one SNa₄Cu₂ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SNa₆Cu pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-64°.
